req.title: List all tasks
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/ with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates GET /tasks/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — baseline list returns all 20 pre-loaded rows with correct shape; (2) positive EP — completed filter returns only matching rows; (3) BVA — skip=0 returns from first row, skip=20 skips all pre-loaded rows; (4) BVA — limit=1 returns exactly 1 item, limit at boundary values 1 and 1000; (5) NEG — invalid skip (negative) returns 422; (6) NEG — invalid limit (0, below ge=1) returns 422; (7) DT — combined skip+limit slices correctly; (8) BVA — limit boundary at ge=1 (limit=0 rejected, limit=1 accepted); (9) positive — response fields match schema (id, title, description, completed, created_at, updated_at). Mutation resilience: exact status codes, exact counts, exact field values from pre-loaded data, both sides of boundary operators tested.

tests.name: test_list_tasks_returns_200_and_all_20_preloaded_rows
actions: Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters
expected: Response body is a JSON array of exactly 20 items
Each item has fields: id, title, description, completed, created_at
trace: R-TASK-004: system shall respond with JSON array of all tasks
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_list_tasks_returns_200_and_all_20_preloaded_rows():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 20
    ids = {item["id"] for item in data}
    assert 1 in ids
    assert 20 in ids
    first = data[0]
    assert "id" in first
    assert "title" in first
    assert "completed" in first
    assert "created_at" in first

tests.name: test_list_tasks_response_schema_fields_for_known_row
preconditions: Database contains pre-loaded row id=2: title='Book flight tickets', completed=true
actions: Find the item with id=2 in the response
expected: Item with id=2 has title='Book flight tickets'
Item with id=2 has description='Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit.'
Item with id=2 has created_at present
trace: R-TASK-004: response JSON array contains correct field values from pre-loaded data
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_list_tasks_response_schema_fields_for_known_row():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/", params={"completed": "true"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    task2 = next((t for t in data if t["id"] == 2), None)
    assert task2 is not None
    assert task2["title"] == "Book flight tickets"
    assert task2["completed"] is True
    assert task2["description"] == "Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit."
    assert task2["created_at"] is not None

tests.name: test_list_tasks_after_create_returns_21_items
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a new task
trace: R-TASK-004: list reflects state after task creation (state transition)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_list_tasks_after_create_returns_21_items():
    client = TestClient(app)
    cr = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "New task for list test", "completed": False})
    assert cr.status_code == 201
    new_id = cr.json()["id"]
    assert new_id == 21
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 21
    ids = {item["id"] for item in data}
    assert new_id in ids
